Author: AlexFlipnote
Name: The Holiest Fluffiness
Punchline: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog:
Find apartment is now much faster and more reliable. Moving between wards no longer teleports back to the city (no more gil spent per ward): it hops to the ward's entrance aetheryte and uses the ferry, gate or Odilie to pick the next ward, in every district.
Walking is smoother: it locks on and runs straight to shards and ferry NPCs, waits until menus have closed before moving, and no longer jumps around when a walk takes a while.
Fixed getting stuck on the side of the Shirogane apartment stairs (both main and subdivision), under the Empyreum shard terraces, and standing still after reading a building's rooms.
